## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant tests run:

## HIG / UI Checklist

- [ ] New or changed controls use shared HIG patterns where practical.
- [ ] Inputs have visible labels or explicit accessible names.
- [ ] Essential help is not hover-only.
- [ ] Interactive targets are large enough for the surrounding context.
- [ ] Responsive wrapping was checked for changed panels.
- [ ] Color is not the only status cue.

## Truthfulness Checklist

- [ ] Heuristic, simulated, fallback, and backtested outputs are labelled accurately.
- [ ] No new wording overclaims prediction accuracy or probability.
- [ ] No lookahead bias was introduced into analytics or backtests.
